environment.description: ECS Fargate service running behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no WAF attached). PostgreSQL RDS with RLS policies enforce tenant isolation at the database layer - each tenant can only read/write their own rows. The container runs with the default Fargate platform version 1.4.0. No Content-Security-Policy headers are configured. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic directly to the container on port 8080.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener, no WAF
config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 14 with RLS policies on comments and reactions tables
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON reactions USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.network: VPC with public ALB, private subnets for tasks
